scope: Timing, transport and calibration-warning pilot only; not the main qualification matrix or clinical validation
rng: NumPy PCG64; SeedSequence(seed).spawn(20), then four children per cohort for means, libraries, batch coefficients and counts
batch_assignment: A,B,A,B at every time; distinct biological unit for every sample
hypothesis_selection: g000 through g031, fixed before drawing counts; no filtering

log_library_distribution.name: normal
log_library_distribution.centering: subtract the 24 sampled log factors' mean, then exponentiate

mean_model: mu[g,s] = gene_mean[g] * library_factor[s] * exp(batch_log_coefficient[g] * I(batch[s] == B)); all temporal coefficients zero

design.basis: Patsy dmatrix: 1 + batch + cr(time, df=3, constraints='center'); batch numeric 0/1

engine_order: edger_qlf then deseq2_lrt within ascending cohort; timings are descriptive and include cold-start/order/emulation effects
native_policy: Frozen native_nb.R performs each complete native pipeline, fixed joint temporal test, no adaptive basis selection, no automatic trend acceptance, no independent filtering, diagnostic-only influence policy

reporting.nominal_interval: Descriptive 95% Student-t interval across complete cohort rejection fractions, clipped to [0,1]; unavailable if any attempt has missing usable p-values
reporting.family_interval: Two-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval for BH any-discovery among completely observed cohorts; incomplete-cohort bounds separately retain all attempts
reporting.paired_comparison: Descriptive 95% Student-t intervals across paired complete-cohort differences in nominal rejection fraction and BH any-discovery; no gene-level independence assumption
reporting.warning_rule: Descriptive interval wholly above nominal 0.05 is a calibration warning; intervals are unadjusted and no acceptance rule is defined
reporting.failure_handling: Preserve every scheduled/attempted cohort; never redraw, replace missing p/q with 1, switch engines/trends, alter family, or rerun a measured attempt; report failure and missingness denominators
reporting.memory_scope: Configured 2g container limit; peak process/container memory not measured
reporting.main_precision_target: Separate 2000 independent cohorts per stochastic cell in docs/native-nb-validation-design.md remains outstanding

integrity: Freeze protocol, runner, driver, dependency lock, all generated inputs, generating parameters and design checks before any native fitting. Recheck frozen files and corresponding source hashes before/after every attempt. Stop on a mismatch without revising scores. Receipts are local SHA-256 evidence, not protected retention or an authenticated clinical signature.
